BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Can Coolers, Bottle Sleeves and Glass Sleeves: Specify the Fit

Use a clear generic product description and actual container dimensions when requesting a sleeve. Similar names do not establish interchangeable fit.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Name the container first

Describe whether the sleeve is for a standard can, slim can, bottle or pint glass. BTAO-004 is a pint-glass sleeve reference and should not be used as evidence of can compatibility.

Send measured fit requirements

Share container height, body diameter and the intended coverage. Review seams, openings, zip or roll-on structure and decoration position on a sample.

Keep material and performance separate

Confirm the final material rather than inferring it from a reference name. Do not assume a thermal duration, universal fit or a particular brand authorization from the catalogue wording.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Container & modelCan, bottle or glass, plus the selected sleeve SKU.
Fit & coverageContainer height, body diameter, coverage and opening structure.
Decoration & deliveryArtwork placement, material, individual packing and arrival requirements.

Make the Next Step Specific
